description: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for several different configurations. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The first line, colored purple and labeled “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.55 by iteration 140000, exhibiting a steep decline in the first 20000 iterations, then leveling off. The second line, colored orange and labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)”, starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.53 by iteration 140000, with a similar initial decline and subsequent leveling. The third line, colored green and labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.52 by iteration 140000, showing a similar pattern. The fourth line, colored magenta and labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”, starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.51 by iteration 140000, following a similar trend. Finally, the fifth line, colored navy and labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.53 by iteration 140000, also exhibiting a similar pattern of decline and leveling.
